{{Quote|Then the Ogemites have joined the Rebellion&ndash;? I thought you traders were all business ... no politics!|Luke Skywalker to Anduvil of Ogem|<ref name="TS">"[[Tatooine Sojourn]]"</ref>}}
'''Ogemites''' were a [[near-Human]] species indigenous to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ogem/Legends|Ogem]]. They had pale skin and large frills of feathery hair on their heads. They were known throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as traders who generally remained politically neutral. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operative [[Anduvil]] was an Ogemite.

==Biology and appearance==
Ogemites were a race of [[near-Human]]s. Though similar to [[Human/Legends|Humans]] in most respects, Ogemites were taller and their hair resembled feathers.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|I was lucky! Very few women become traders on Ogem!|Anduvil of Ogem|<ref name="TS" />}}
Ogemites society was divided along [[Gender/Legends|gender]] lines, with Ogemite males carrying on a proud tradition of [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Very few females became traders, though it sometimes occurred when a daughter inherited her father's business when there was no male heir.<ref name="TS" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Empire's credit is overextended! The Rebellion pays in cash!|Anduvil of Ogem|<ref name="TS" />}}
The Ogemites were native to [[Ogem/Legends|Ogem]], a planet located in the [[D'Aelgoth sector/Legends|D'Aelgoth sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] along the [[D'Aelgoth Trade Route]]. Ogem was located in a region of space that was primarily explored between [[3000 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. Around 1000 BBY, wealthy [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlders]] led by [[Thull Vandron]] settled the nearby [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region and established a number of [[Noble/Legends|noble]] houses. A millennium later, Ogem was a bustling trade world, and Ogemite merchants were tentatively attempting to establish trade relations with several [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex]] families that had a more progressive outlook than their neighbors. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Ogem was located in space held by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The Ogemite focus on business meant that they avoided siding in political activity, and thus they at first were neutral in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. However, following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] overextended their line of credit with Ogemite traders.<ref name="TS" /> This lead many of them to side with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]],<ref name="Anduvil" /> as the Rebellion paid up front for the goods they bought.<ref name="TS" />

==Ogemites in the galaxy==
{{Quote|The Empire is transmitting data on Rebel base locations by unknown means-! Already, it's resulted in destruction of several of your outposts ... Ogem's markets!|Anduvil of Ogem|<ref name="TS" />}}
Ogemites were widely known as apolitical traders in the galaxy.<ref name="TS" /> Their world was a bustling trade world on the D'Aelgoth Trade Route, which connected the Senex and Juvex worlds with the worlds of the [[D'Aelgoth sector/Legends|D'Aelgoth sector]] and, ultimately, the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]].<ref name="TEA" /> When the Empire overextended its credit with Ogemite merchants, many sided with the Rebel Alliance. Among the disaffected Ogemites was [[Anduvil]] of Ogem, daughter of an Ogemite trader who bequeathed his business to her after he died from [[Bledsoe's disease]].<ref name="TS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ogemites were created by [[Russ Manning]] in the form of Anduvil of Ogem in "[[Tatooine Sojourn]]," a story arc of the [[Star Wars (comic strip)|Star Wars comic strip]] printed in [[1979]]. "Tatooine Sojourn" was reformatted and colored by [[Dark Horse Comics]] in [[1994]] to become [[Classic Star Wars: The Early Adventures 4|''Classic Star Wars: The Early Adventures'' 4]], later reprinted as part of the [[Star Wars comic books|trade paperback]] collection of [[Classic Star Wars: The Early Adventures (trade paperback)|''The Early Adventures'']]. The daily newspaper installments were later released online as part of [[StarWars.com]]'s series of webstrips on [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]].

Other than Anduvil, Ogemites have not appeared in any other story, though Anduvil received an entry in the StarWars.com [[Databank (original)|Databank]]. Ogemites also received an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' in [[2008]], and were briefly discussed in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' in [[2009]].
